title: Pressure Roast Chicken Stock
summary: Rich, gelatinous stock in about an hour from a rotisserie chicken and a pressure cooker.
difficulty_reason: Brown some vegetables, add everything to the pressure cooker and strain.

ingredients.line: Neutral oil or chicken fat, as needed
150 g yellow onion (about 1/2 onion), thinly sliced

steps: Heat enough chicken fat or neutral oil to coat the bottom of a pressure cooker over medium-high heat.
Add the carrot, onion and garlic and let them sear without stirring until browned at the edges.
Pull all the meat off the chicken and separate it from the bones.
Shred the meat finely or puree it in a food processor.
Add the bones, shredded meat and water to the pot.
Pressure cook on high for 30 to 90 minutes, then let it cool without venting, or vent very slowly.
Strain the stock through a fine sieve.
tips: 30 minutes equals about 2 to 3 hours of stovetop simmering; 90 minutes equals 7 to 8 hours.
Cooling without venting keeps the stock clear.
source_notes: Ingredients and steps from the recipe page; yield about 2 liters.
